name: Luna Wedler
bio: Luna Sofia Wedler was born in October 1999 in Bachenbülach, Zürich, Switzerland. She is an actress known for Das schönste Mädchen der Welt (2018), Blue My Mind (2017) and Dem Horizont so nah (2019).

credits.title: Windstärke 17
credits.overview: After her alcoholic mother’s suicide, Ida - traumatized and plagued by guilt - flees her hometown and ends up on the island of Rügen. There, she begins an intense healing process marked by a fresh start, an unexpected friendship, and her first great love.

credits.title: Eurotrash
credits.overview: A writer sets off on a road trip through Switzerland with his drunk and terminally ill mother, after realizing his wealthy family members are the very worst kind of people.

credits.title: The Rainbow Fish
credits.overview: The rainbow fish, an outsider obsessed with his glittering scales, learns the power of friendship on an adventurous sea voyage with the little blue fish. He finds his place in a colorful fish community—and realizes that sharing brings people together.

credits.title: The Girl with the Leica
credits.overview: On Bastille Day in 1937, pioneering German-Jewish photojournalist Gerda Taro spends her final day in Paris confronting her past, her complex partnership with Robert Capa, and her absolute commitment to anti-fascist resistance before returning to the front lines of the Spanish Civil War.

credits.overview: The musically highly gifted maid Elsie, who longs for a career as a musician, is forced into marriage with Jacob, a young stable boy who dreams of owning his own horse. Both have to learn that they can only escape their lack of opportunities if they team up.

credits.overview: When Ingeborg Bachmann and Max Frisch meet for the first time in Paris in the summer of 1958, they are already international celebrities of the literary world. In the four years that follow, they dabble in great love and an open relationship between his hometown of Zurich and her adopted Rome.

credits.overview: Jewish aesthete Cioma, 21, does not let anyone take away his joy of life, especially not the Nazis. In 1942, he has to find new ways to make his living in Berlin and escape deportation. In the process he discovers his talent for forgery: not only with passports, but also his own identity.

credits.title: The Story of My Wife
credits.overview: A sea captain makes a bet in a cafe with a friend that he will marry the first woman who walks in.

credits.title: Soul of a Beast
credits.overview: During the summer, Gabriel, a teenage father, falls in love with the mysterious Corey, the girlfriend of Joel, his best friend, who, deeply hurt, reveals the truth about Gabriel's past.

credits.title: Auerhaus
credits.overview: Four troubled friends who despite the feeling that they live standardized lives share a flat under the sceptical looks of their neighbours.

credits.title: Close to the Horizon
credits.overview: Jessica knows exactly what her life is supposed to look like and where it takes her. But then she meets Danny. He has a complicated past and could confuse all their plans. Jessica has to decide.

credits.title: Midnight Runner
credits.overview: Marathon runner Jonas Widmer is looking for a way to overcome his tragic past. As a result, he becomes more and more entangled in an ominous double life. The true drama about a well-known top athlete, who evolves into a serial offender.

credits.title: Streaker
credits.overview: A high school teacher who is wrestling with a financial crisis dreams up a get-rich-quick scheme involving streakers and illegal sports betting.

credits.title: Blue My Mind
credits.overview: 15-year-old Mia faces an overwhelming transformation which puts her entire existence into question. Her body is changing radically, and despite desperate attempts to halt the process, Mia is soon forced to accept that nature is far more powerful than she is.

credits.title: Torn
credits.overview: When a convicted felon fails to return from his prison leave and a young woman is found murdered, forensic psychiatrist Roman Mettler finds himself fighting for his existence. It was him who had composed the report permitting the leave.
